# SameDayRepairs.com.au - Emergency Repair & Trade Directory

> Australia's verified on-demand emergency trade directory. Connecting homeowners and commercial premises with licensed whitegoods technicians, emergency plumbers, 24/7 locksmiths, electricians, and garage door specialists with guaranteed same-day arrival.

## Emergency Hotline
- **Direct Dispatch Line**: 0468 991 300
- **International**: +61 468 991 300
- **Hours**: 24/7 Priority Emergency Intake

## Core Services & Capabilities
- **Appliance & Whitegoods Repairs**: Samsung, LG, Fisher & Paykel, Bosch, Westinghouse, Smeg fridge/freezer cooling failures, washing machine pump errors, and oven element breakdowns. (Diagnostic callout from $149, waived on approved repair).
- **Emergency Plumbing**: Burst water mains, leaking flexi-hoses, blocked sewer lines, leaking hot water systems (Rheem, Dux, Rinnai). (Diagnostic callout from $149).
- **24/7 Emergency Locksmiths**: Residential lockouts, broken key extraction, commercial rekeying, electronic deadbolt failure. (Callout from $165).
- **Emergency Electricians**: Tripped RCD safety switches, sparking power points, switchboard repairs, power restoration. (Diagnostic callout from $149).
- **Garage Door Repairs**: Broken torsion springs, snapped cables, motor gear failures, doors jammed off-track. (Callout from $160).
- **Roadside Mobile Mechanics**: On-site battery replacement, alternator testing, no-start triage. (Callout from $149).

## Trade Guarantees & Compliance
- **Licensing**: All contractors audited against QBCC (Queensland), Fair Trading (NSW), and Victorian Building Authority (VBA).
- **Insurance**: $20 Million Public Liability certificate of currency required.
- **Warranty**: All replacement parts and workmanship backed by minimum 12-month statutory guarantee.
- **Payment**: Mobile on-van EFTPOS terminals with instant GST tax invoices.
